mutations.because: X36 calibrates the web project's testTimeout to 15000ms after X30/X32/X34 made the tests faster; the pin test exists so that setting the value back to Vitest's 5000ms default — the uncalibrated number that was the last blocker for VE3b1 — fails, rather than silently restoring the threshold nobody chose. node/api/tools are asserted unset, so this mutation is the web-only setting, not a root-level inherit.
